description: Replication Dataset for “The Cost of Green Autonomy: EU Photovoltaic De-Risking and Wholesale Electricity Prices in Spain is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors XUAN CHEN YE DAI. This dataset contains the data, analytical models, and replication files supporting the article: “The cost of green autonomy: EU photovoltaic de-risking and wholesale electricity prices in Spain”. The dataset includes: • Raw data collected from EMBER Energies, Red Eléctrica de España (REE), Eurostat, and other public sources. Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
